correctness.rationale: Exact fixed-point derivative cancellation is verified algebraically. Both period-two lifted equations have nonzero Jacobian determinant five at their cat seeds, ensuring analytic continuation. Uniform Taylor expansions and the exact 2-step derivative matrix identity give respectively the strictly positive and unequal coefficients (25−7√5)/2 and (25+7√5)/2. C1 conjugacy preserves traces at primitive 2-cycles, proving the obstruction. The packaged Python program independently checks finite examples; finite tests are not used as proof.

value.rationale: The source fixed-point trace has a natural exact exceptional curve, on which the entire fixed-point linearization coincides with the undeformed cat map. Two explicitly continued primitive cycles detect deformation at quadratic order with distinct golden-ratio coefficients. This is a meaningful quantitative separation of local fixed-point data from differentiable dynamical rigidity, not an arbitrary parameter choice or a reproduction of the known map.
